_note: Curated 2026-09-25 from the Sonnet cleanup suggestions (data/world/cleanup.json): only clans, iwi, bands and divisions of ONE people are merged. Distinct peoples inside an umbrella stay separate: Hopi/Zuni/Tewa (not 'Puebloan'), Dene and Coast Salish nations, Maya peoples, Malagasy peoples (not Merina), Bretons, Csángós, Pomaks, Fante, Lanna, Konyak, Kalaallit, Miao, Mthwakazi. Wrong suggestions not applied: Vezo/Zafimaniry/Antemoro/Bezanozano -> Merina, Mpongwe -> Fang, Iñupiaq <-> Yupik.

_atlas_not.Brong people: a separate Akan people, not Asante
_atlas_not.Herero people: own people; the atlas Himba page only borrows the BM Herero facet
_atlas_not.Kabyle people: Algerian Berber people, distinct from the atlas's Moroccan Berber
_atlas_not.Kuki people: related to, not part of, the Chin
